Eve: Late shift handoff — quick notes. Regen latency hit ~350ms at 02:10 UTC, partially recovered. KV proxy memory creeping, no OOM yet. PRs pending.

Jonah: thx, any customer impact?

Eve: no customer-facing errors. Some 504s for internal batch regen jobs, routed to fallback model-v1-compact.

Priya: which PRs are blocking the regen fix?

Eve: #4390 (regen backoff) and #4402 (model-fallback-selection). Jonah can merge if green.

Carlos: kvproxy mem: pods on p3-pool-2 showing RSS ~1.9GB (limit 2GB). I scaled deployment to 4 replicas and set HPA min=3.

Mei: create runbook snippet for memory trace please. Also, set alert A-7812 for memory > 1.8GB in that pool.

Carlos: done — snippet added under "kvproxy memory growth" and alert created A-7812.

Sam: I'll take the code review for #4390 after lunch. small comment on jitter calc.

DeployBot: Canary deploy router=regen canary=eu-regen-2 started at 2025-01-18T02:13:45Z — status: success :white_check_mark:

MonitorBot: alert A-7804: regen-latency > 300ms at 02:10 UTC — closed at 02:25 UTC (mitigated)

Jonah: action items: Sam merge PRs, Carlos continue mem snapshots every 10m, Mei monitor alerts and escalate if A-7812 fires, Priya follow up with docs. I'll pick up coverage for next 2 hours.

Eve: handing off. I'll be reachable for 20 mins. Posting snapshots now.

Carlos: snapshot: p3-pool-2 mem usage: 1.88GB, 1.92GB, 1.85GB over last 30m. no OOMs.

Mei: I'll check EU regen SLO for +1h and update thread. will ping oncall-2 if anything new.
